body.title: Error 522: Connection timed out
body.detail: Cloudflare could not establish a TCP connection to the origin server. The TCP handshake timed out, which may indicate the origin is overloaded, firewalling Cloudflare, or unreachable at the network level.
body.what_you_should_do: **Wait and retry.** Back off for at least 120 seconds. If the error persists, the website operator should verify firewall rules and ensure the origin accepts connections from Cloudflare IP ranges.
body.footer: This error was generated by Cloudflare on behalf of the website owner.
